invariants.rationale: Returned map is instantiated before return and never replaced with null.
Map is only populated with PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key() if a condition holds; otherwise, remains empty.
Population of the map correlates directly with the presence of clustering sort columns.
At most one key-value pair may be added based on the code path.
The only (optional) value is the result of getClusteringSortColumns(), which is checked non-empty before insertion.
